note: Everything here is provisional and concept_local_state. Canon is never minted in a concept register; the implementation audit censuses Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md and adjudicates exact ids.

census.observation: Waypoint drives every surface through one dest grammar plus the shared trigger registry; it needs no per-destination command ids at all. Any surviving cmd.settings.open_* aliases collapse into cmd.settings.navigate {dest}.

flags.note: Per-destination openers are aliases of cmd.settings.navigate {dest}; the dest object carries cat/sub/managerId/objectId/tab/settingId exactly as PM2.route serializes it.
Managers are not slides; Waypoint exposes no sequential manager navigation anywhere. Back is one level out, always named.
Project-only model: no scope selectors exist. Legacy scope words appear only as impact prose inside row Details.

families_exercised: search (cmd.settings.search {query}; selection routes by rid/dest, never index)
value mutation (cmd.settings.set {settingId, value} -> store.setValue with validation receipts)
copy transaction (preview / apply / rollback against PM2.copy tokens and receipts)

manager actions (shared trigger registry: provider-refresh, catalog-refresh, reconnect, invoke-test, install-scan, install-update, install-repair, install-acquire, backup-now, index-rebuild, cleanup-dry-run, ...)
families_exercised_note: All five families run through shared modules (PM2.route, PM2.search, store.setValue, PM2.copy, def.actions->PM2.states.op); the concept adds zero private verbs.

new_candidates.payload: { dest: {route, cat?, sub?, managerId?, objectId?, tab?, settingId?, query?}, focus?: rid }
new_candidates.note: The single navigation verb behind cards, destination rows, rail, breadcrumb, attention items, banner actions, jump buttons, and search selection. Focus rid drives the exact-row landing sequence.
Materializes as the #/search/<query> history entry so Back deterministically restores the query and its result list.
Validation failures return {ok:false,error} and render inline at the row; success emits the value event and a receipt. No optimistic UI.
Maps 1:1 to PM2.copy; apply is restore-point -> atomic write -> read-back verify; rollback restores exactly and re-emits a value batch.

The landing tail of navigate: scroll to center, focus, calm decaying pm2-located; when the rid names an unavailable capability the availability reason is surfaced at the landing (u: results land on the owner-shell head with the reason note).

drift_census_2026_08_13.note: This concept register does not re-count the catalog; the 2026-08-13 performance/provider adjudications are honored behaviorally (no probe storms, explicit CLI acquisition, truthful ObservableWork) rather than re-adjudicated.
